items.title: Campus Roadshow — Delhi NCR
items.summary: The movement arrives on campus: orientation, idea scouting and first conversations with the ecosystem.
items.description: A one-day campus roadshow that introduces LaunchBharat to students and faculty, opens idea scouting for the national cohort, and connects early participants with regional mentors. Sessions cover how the movement works, what the journey to the Grand Finale looks like, and how ideas at any stage can take the first step.

items.title: Innovation Bootcamp — Mumbai
items.summary: Two days of structured idea development — from problem statement to a pitch that stands up.
items.description: A two-day working bootcamp for shortlisted participants. Day one focuses on problem discovery, users and market reality; day two turns validated thinking into a clear, honest pitch. Mentors work with teams in small groups throughout.

items.title: Regional Pitch Day — Bengaluru
items.summary: Regional finalists pitch to a panel of founders, investors and industry leaders.
items.description: The southern region's pitch day. Selected teams present to a panel drawn from the startup ecosystem; the strongest ideas advance toward the national stage. Open audience sessions run alongside the closed panel reviews.

items.title: Campus Roadshow — Jaipur
items.summary: Taking the movement beyond the metros — orientation and idea scouting in Rajasthan.
items.description: A campus roadshow focused on first-time founders and student innovators in Rajasthan. Orientation, idea scouting and mentor conversations, with dedicated support for participants applying from smaller towns.

items.title: Ecosystem Forum — Hyderabad
items.summary: Institutions, incubators and industry align on how the movement scales in the region.
items.description: An invite-first forum bringing together colleges, incubators, investors and industry partners to coordinate the movement's regional pipeline — hosting, mentorship, and pathways for advancing teams.

items.title: National Orientation — Online
items.summary: A nationwide online orientation: what LaunchBharat is, how to participate, and what happens next.
items.description: The single best starting point for anyone anywhere in India. A live online orientation covering the movement, the journey from campus to the Grand Finale, and how students, founders, colleges and mentors participate.
